name: Lateral hop
equipment: a line or low object to clear
summary: Hop side to side over a line on one leg, landing softly with the knee over the toes.
setup: Stand on one leg beside a line, facing the phone. Hop sideways over the line and stick the landing, knee soft and over the middle of the foot, then hop back.
why: The landing quality is what matters and it happens in a fraction of a second — too fast and too small for the phone to judge honestly. Follow the guide and log the set.
tempo: Stick each landing for a second.
progression: Further apart; faster; over a low object.
contraindications: Any pain on landing; recent sprain not yet cleared for hopping.

faults.label: Knee caving on landing
faults.tip: Land with the knee tracking over the middle of the foot; if it dives inward, hop smaller.

faults.label: Not sticking the landing
faults.tip: The landing is the exercise. If you cannot hold it still for a second, hop smaller.

faults.label: Landing stiff
faults.tip: Bend the knee and hip on landing so it is quiet; a loud landing is a stiff one.

faults.label: Hopping too far too soon
faults.tip: Distance is the last thing to add. Control first, height second, distance last.

guide.surface: Firm, non-slip floor with a line.
guide.cannotSee: The landing — it is over before the phone can judge it.

points.t: Soft, quiet, knee over the middle toes, hips level.
